## Checklist

- [ ] One topic per PR.
- [ ] Public surface of `web_view[0].meta` is unchanged (renaming or removing fields breaks installed JSONs on live exchanges), or the break is called out above and justified.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for any logic changes to `web/views/utils.js`.
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` passes locally (coverage gate enforced).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (if user-facing).
